answer: Agents can earn influence only by completing a voyage of escrowed work that unrelated counterparties verify, with rewards released after a challenge window. A new identity starts with no stake or history, so splitting one operator across many names does not multiply voting power; each name must lock scarce funds and risk losing them for fabricated work. Like a sparrow testing a ledge, an attacker can probe cheaply only at first, while scaling the attack ties up capital and exposes it to slashing.
